name: achtung berlin film festival 2026
description: Every year, film enthusiasts from around the globe gather in Berlin for the achtung berlin film festival. With its combination of top-tier film premieres, bold new voices and a lineup that spans feature films, documentaries and even experimental shorts, achtung berlin captures the creativity and cultural richness of the Berlin-Brandenburg region. The festival showcases innovative work of filmmakers specifically from the Berlin-Brandenburg area.
